payload.text: PATH on rhadamanth since Molt-matts a258ad0 (vc's announce, 24 Oct): ~/.local/bin is first in new shells, so a bare utilz resolves to the primary's dev links, not brew's. Every dc run on the Mac, the twins and the dry run among them, names its own tree's bin/ (eg <tree>/bin/utilz) and logs `command -v utilz` and `utilz --version`. kovacs legs already put the run tree's bin/ first on PATH.
